race.description: Copy Bets With Tabtouch Bet Loop Mdn
race.comment: TAG TIME (2) was solid first-up at this track and trip, beaten 1L in a strong performance as the race favourite. The form out of that race has been super and he now gets the blinkers on. This shapes similarly and with further improvement in store, he can knock over the maiden. MYSTIC EMPRESS (4) missed by 0.8L at Pinjarra last time out and steps out to 1300m now. She comes here off a freshen and the rise in trip looks to suit on what she's done her past couple. Will need a touch of luck from the barrier, but she can feature in the finish. MISS COSMOPOLITAN (11) has shown enough at the trials to suggest she can run a strong race on debut. Tsang's been on board at the trials and sticks for her debut. Wide draw is a niggle, but she can feature in a suitable race. MAGIC BLUE POINT (5) can improve back out in trip. PROFOUND BENEFIT (1) won't be far away.
